nodes.description: ERC20Interface.totalSupply() abstract declaration returning total token supply.
ERC20Interface.balanceOf(address) abstract declaration returning a holder balance.
ERC20Interface.allowance(address,address) abstract declaration returning remaining spender allowance.
ERC20Interface.transfer(address,uint) abstract declaration.
ERC20Interface.approve(address,uint) abstract declaration.
ERC20Interface.transferFrom(address,address,uint) abstract declaration.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint) pure helper computing c = a + b and requiring c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint) pure helper requiring b <= a then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint) pure helper computing c = a * b with overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint,uint) pure helper requiring b > 0 then c = a / b.
ParkShiba constructor: sets name/symbol/decimals, mints _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
ParkShiba.totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
ParkShiba.balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ParkShiba.allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
ParkShiba.approve(address,uint) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
ParkShiba.transfer(address,uint) debits msg.sender and credits recipient using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
ParkShiba.transferFrom(address,address,uint) debits from, debits allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits to using SafeMath.
Public string state variable holding the token name 'Park Shiba'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'PShiba'.
Public uint8 state variable for decimals (18).
Public uint256 _totalSupply holding the minted token amount.
Internal mapping(address => uint) balances holding holder balances.
Internal mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding spend allowances.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller identity used for minting, allowance ownership and balance debiting.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer: balance decrement arithmetic on a caller-supplied amount.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer: balance credit to caller-supplied address.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom: debits an arbitrary 'from' address supplied by the caller.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens): implicit (non-explicit require) allowance spend enforced only by safeSub.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom: credits caller-supplied 'to' address.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens inside approve: unconditional overwrite of allowance by the caller (no zero-reset guard).

edges.reason: constructor assigns the whole initial supply to balances[msg.sender], an externally controlled identity.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner, so the caller controls which allowance slot is written.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller the implicit authorization subject.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
allowed[from][msg.sender] decrement is indexed by the untrusted caller identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], an authorization write keyed by the untrusted caller.

parameter b flows into c = a + b inside safeAdd.
parameter a flows into the guarded subtraction inside safeSub.
parameter b is the subtrahend checked by require(b <= a) in safeSub.
parameter a flows into c = a * b inside safeMul.
parameter b flows into c = a * b inside safeMul.
parameter a is the dividend of c = a / b in safeDiv.
parameter b is the divisor guarded by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.
tokenOwner is used directly as the balanceOf mapping key.
tokenOwner is the outer key of the allowance lookup.
spender is the inner key of the allowance lookup.
spender is the address granted an allowance in approve.
tokens becomes the value of the granted allowance in approve.
recipient address to flows into transfer's balance credit expression.
caller-supplied amount tokens flows into the balance arithmetic of transfer.
from is the account debited by transferFrom without an explicit allowance require.
recipient address to flows into transferFrom's balance credit expression.

tokens parameter is the subtrahend in safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
